entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Well. Thanks to the efforts of my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. Thanks to the efforts of my ministry and the funding allocated by the President, Gruni is looking stable these days."

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: ""Stable? That's it?""
entries.dialogueText: "Stable? That's it?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus shrugged."
entries.dialogueText: Gus shrugged.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Well. I'm saddened to say that des..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. I'm saddened to say that despite my ministry's best efforts, we're going to have to close the books on this project."

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: ""'Close the books', Mr. Manger? Wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Close the books', Mr. Manger? What does that mean?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus sighed."
entries.dialogueText: Gus sighed.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""It means that without a massive in..."
entries.dialogueText: "It means that without a massive injection of funding, the economic growth I had hoped to see in the region is simply not going to happen during this term."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""It's far from the massive surge in..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's far from the massive surge in economic growth that I had hoped to see. But I still believe the area has a wealth of untapped potential."

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: ""I've been keeping an eye on Gruni..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been keeping an eye on Gruni as well, of course. And it does seem to be experiencing a surge in economic growth."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus smiled proudly."
entries.dialogueText: Gus smiled proudly.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""Wine production, shipping, agricul..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wine production, shipping, agriculture... the investments are pouring in. I'd call this turnaround a beacon of success for our administration."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""This is everything I'd hoped to se..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is everything I'd hoped to see at the start of our term and more."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Well, don't celebrate too early. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, don't celebrate too early. The term isn't over yet."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Congratulations, Gus. I know how m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Congratulations, Gus. I know how much this project meant to you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's fantastic news. It shows wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's fantastic news. It shows what can be accomplished when the president, cabinet and Assembly all work together."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It seems to me like my remaining t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems to me like my remaining time in office would be better spent focusing on other regions."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Terrific. Gruni is the breadbasket..."
entries.dialogueText: "Terrific. Gruni is the breadbasket of Sordland. Its success will benefit us all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Well, keep at it. I know how much..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, keep at it. I know how much Gruni means to you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All right. I'll see what I can do..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. I'll see what I can do to help boost development there."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You can't just give up. I know how..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't just give up. I know how much Gruni means to you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I knew it from the beginning. It m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew it from the beginning. It made no sense to try to turn Gruni into something it wasn't."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Perhaps this wouldn't be happening..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps this wouldn't be happening if you'd focused as much attention on Gruni as you have on your side ventures."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""What could have been a beacon of s..."
entries.dialogueText: "What could have been a beacon of success for Sordland is turning into a cesspool of crime, unemployment and homelessness."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus gritted his teeth."
entries.dialogueText: Gus gritted his teeth.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""If Gruni is failing, it is not for..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Gruni is failing, it is not for my lack of trying. You have no idea how much blood, sweat and tears I put into my development plan."

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: ""I still believe it's brimming with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still believe it's brimming with untapped potential. It saddens me to no end to see that go to waste."

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: ""Try to calm down, Gus. The Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "Try to calm down, Gus. The President makes decisions on behalf of the entire country, not only your home region."

entries.dialogueText: "My ministry was notified about the Rumburgian infiltrator."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci

entries.dialogueText: "This is a very delicate situation, Anton."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What's delicate about it? They sen..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's delicate about it? They sent us a sex spy. They'll have to answer for it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I understand. Our relations with R..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. Our relations with Rumburg were precarious enough before this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You don't have to tell me that.""
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have to tell me that."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""How are you, Anton? You look as if..."
entries.dialogueText: "How are you, Anton? You look as if you haven't slept in ages."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's been a rough few days, Deivid.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's been a rough few days, Deivid."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Sleeplessness comes part and parce..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sleeplessness comes part and parcel with this job. You know that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're better off not knowing.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're better off not knowing."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Can I ask you a personal question?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can I ask you a personal question? Were you ever unfaithful to Cathrin?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He blinked, slightly taken aback."
entries.dialogueText: He blinked, slightly taken aback.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I've met many a beautiful woman in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've met many a beautiful woman in the course of my travels. But no, even in my younger days, I was never tempted to stray."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""My deep love for my wife -- as wel..."
entries.dialogueText: "My deep love for my wife -- as well as the need to protect my reputation as a statesman -- prevented me from doing so."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Why? Have you broken your vows wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why? Have you broken your vows with Monica, Anton?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This isn't about me. This is about..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't about me. This is about Petr."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Forget I asked. Let's talk diploma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forget I asked. Let's talk diplomacy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. Although God knows I've though..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. Although God knows I've thought about it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Never. I love my wife more than an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never. I love my wife more than anything."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me sternly."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me sternly.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Some thoughts are better off not t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some thoughts are better off not translated into actions."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked relieved."
entries.dialogueText: He looked relieved.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Some men go their entire lives wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some men go their entire lives without finding what you and I have. Best not to mess it up."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me sadly."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me sadly.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Men of our stature are granted a c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Men of our stature are granted a certain power in society. Some know how to wield it responsibly, and others do not."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I see that Mr. Vectern wants to do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see that Mr. Vectern wants to do right by his wife and his position. I hope someday he finds the strength to face his demons."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Yes, we should leave this topic fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we should leave this topic for another day."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I'll be very brief. Perhaps we can..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll be very brief. Perhaps we can even carve out some time for you to rest your eyes."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""But let's have this conversation o..."
entries.dialogueText: "But let's have this conversation over tea, not during a cabinet meeting."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I'm very glad to report that our d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm very glad to report that our diplomatic efforts with Rumburg have been met with an equally diplomatic response from the Kingdom."

entries.dialogueText: "Prior to this revelation, our diplomatic efforts with Rumburg had been met with an equally diplomatic response."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""In fact, there were indications th..."
entries.dialogueText: "In fact, there were indications that the Kingdom would soon be ready to begin peace talks."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Bringing Rumburg to justice for wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bringing Rumburg to justice for what it's done is far more important than reconciliation."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""But we must exercise caution. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we must exercise caution. The slightest provocation on either side could cost us our chance at reconciliation."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're right as usual. The last th..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right as usual. The last thing we want is a war on our hands."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't even know if peace is poss..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't even know if peace is possible after so many years of animosity."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""There is always hope for peace. No..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is always hope for peace. No matter what."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""The quest for 'justice' has blinde..."
entries.dialogueText: "The quest for 'justice' has blinded many a leader over the centuries. Don't let it cloud your eyes."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""A compromise in the name of the gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "A compromise in the name of the greater good may spare countless lives."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""For better or for worse, we are no..."
entries.dialogueText: "For better or for worse, we are now in a military alliance with the Republic of Valgsland."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""That would be General Lancea with..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would be General Lancea with a further update on the Valgsland alliance. If you don't mind, I'll stay for that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Of course, Deivid. It's always val..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Deivid. It's always valuable having you around."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A military update on Valgsland? I..."
entries.dialogueText: "A military update on Valgsland? I think I have an idea what this could be about."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm already starting to wonder whe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm already starting to wonder whether that alliance was a good idea."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef brusquely entered and took a..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef brusquely entered and took a seat facing me. He and Deivid nodded at each other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He paused, as if he couldn't bring..."
entries.dialogueText: He paused, as if he couldn't bring himself to go on. Finally, he continued.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""As I expected, the commies -- Valg..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I expected, the commies -- Valgslandians -- began asking for our assistance practically as soon as the ink was dry."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Sordland's recognition of Heljilan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland's recognition of Heljiland as Valgish territory has emboldened the Republic to begin planning its invasion of the island."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Their war minister has informed me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their war minister has informed me that it will commence in the coming months."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And? What role is Sordland expecte..."
entries.dialogueText: "And? What role is Sordland expected to play in this invasion?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Time for our armies to practice sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Time for our armies to practice shooting Agnolians."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I hope they're not planning anythi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope they're not planning anything too drastic."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good. I'm happy to help our brothe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I'm happy to help our brothers-in-arms claim their rightful land."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Not an active one, thankfully.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not an active one, thankfully."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""There'll be no need for that, than..."
entries.dialogueText: "There'll be no need for that, thankfully."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""If they are, they're leaving us ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they are, they're leaving us out of it."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Thankfully, they're not asking us..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thankfully, they're not asking us to play an active role."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""We are readying our forces for ass..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are readying our forces for assistance with aerial reconnaissance and a naval blockade. But our troops will not set foot on the island itself."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I too expected that allying with V..."
entries.dialogueText: "I too expected that allying with Valgsland would necessitate our involvement in the Heljiland situation. I'm grateful that's as far as it goes."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""The Valgs had better not back down..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Valgs had better not back down if it comes to war between Sordland and Rumburg, that's for sure."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our Valgish comrades will surely c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our Valgish comrades will surely come to our aid."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""I'll leave you to it, Anton. I kno..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll leave you to it, Anton. I know you've got a lot on your plate."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's always a pleasure, Deivid.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's always a pleasure, Deivid."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for your brevity. Have a go..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for your brevity. Have a good day."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll talk soon.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll talk soon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deivid left the White Room, gently..."
entries.dialogueText: Deivid left the White Room, gently closing the door behind him.

entries.title: Player: ""I hope you will not let your perso..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you will not let your personal feelings about the Republic of Valgsland undermine this alliance, General."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This alliance was not my first cho..."
entries.dialogueText: "This alliance was not my first choice either. But I do trust Valgsland to provide assistance if we're in need."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""May it never come to that.""
entries.dialogueText: "May it never come to that."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""Agreed.""

entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Comrades, eh? You're starting to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Comrades, eh? You're starting to sound like them."

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Of course not, Mr. President. Sord..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course not, Mr. President. Sordland's allies are my own."

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""They could prove to be a formidabl..."
entries.dialogueText: "They could prove to be a formidable ally indeed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He glanced at Iosef."
entries.dialogueText: He glanced at Iosef.

entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: ""If that's all, Mr. Lancea, I sugge..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's all, Mr. Lancea, I suggest we leave President Rayne to it. It's been a long morning."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deivid glanced at him."
entries.dialogueText: Deivid glanced at him.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""All right, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "All right, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and Deivid stood up."
entries.dialogueText: He and Deivid stood up.

entries.speaker: Iosef Lancea
entries.title: Iosef Lancea: ""Hope you tear those Rumburgians a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hope you tear those Rumburgians a new one for installing a damn spy in your office."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Have a good afternoon, gentlemen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a good afternoon, gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They'll get what's coming to them...."
entries.dialogueText: "They'll get what's coming to them. Don't worry."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you both for the updates.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you both for the updates."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll speak again soon.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll speak again soon."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My ministers left. Deivid gently cl..."
entries.dialogueText: My ministers left. Deivid gently closed the door behind them, allowing me a moment of quiet once more.

entries.title: Narrator: "Paskal walked in next. He didn't bo..."
entries.dialogueText: Paskal walked in next. He didn't bother taking a seat.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""Mr. President. Only a brief update..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. Only a brief update from me today."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""My ministry has been working on a..."
entries.dialogueText: "My ministry has been working on a pair of bills that will soon go to the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""The first is a measure to provide..."
entries.dialogueText: "The first is a measure to provide state benefits to all citizens who are forced to miss work due to long-term illness or disability."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's a good idea, Paskal. Those..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a good idea, Paskal. Those people have enough to worry about without fearing for their financial security."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Aren't you afraid that will lead t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aren't you afraid that will lead to more workers going on indefinite 'sick leave' for made-up reasons?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It should be up to companies to pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "It should be up to companies to pay those workers' salaries. Not the government."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All right. What's the other one?""
entries.dialogueText: "All right. What's the other one?"

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""Ideally, perhaps, but not all comp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ideally, perhaps, but not all companies -- especially small businesses -- can afford such generosity."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""This measure would ensure every si..."
entries.dialogueText: "This measure would ensure every sick or disabled employee has access to equal benefits without disincentivizing businesses from hiring those employees."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""This doesn't seem to have happened..."
entries.dialogueText: "This doesn't seem to have happened in other countries that introduced such measures, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""Exactly, Mr. President. Receiving..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly, Mr. President. Receiving these benefits may even help them recover and get back to work faster."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""The second is called the Children..."
entries.dialogueText: "The second is called the Children for Future Act. It would provide direct financial support for low-income families with children, while ensuring that the children of unemployed parents have access to education and healthcare."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Very good. Children are indeed our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Very good. Children are indeed our future, even if they are not born into wealth."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So you're advocating we *pay* our..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you're advocating we *pay* our poorest citizens to reproduce. What could go wrong with that?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""These seem like quite lavish expen..."
entries.dialogueText: "These seem like quite lavish expenditures, Paskal."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""The aim is for all children to hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "The aim is for all children to have a chance to thrive, regardless of their background."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""Yes, every child deserves a chance..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, every child deserves a chance to thrive, regardless of background."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""For a Sordland where every child i..."
entries.dialogueText: "For a Sordland where every child is given a chance to thrive regardless of background, it will be worth it."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""Look for these measures to cross y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look for these measures to cross your desk soon. Assuming they're approved by the Assembly, of course."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Paskal Beniwoll: ""We will discuss everything else in..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will discuss everything else in more detail during our upcoming annual health report."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm looking forward to it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Paskal.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Paskal."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Have a great day.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a great day."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Paskal nodded and exited the room."
entries.dialogueText: Paskal nodded and exited the room.
